summary: Iter29 pre-payroll budget check / anti-fraud guardrail — 100% of the requested UI flows tested end-to-end on preview URL and PASSED. Gov-admin (admin@gov.sl) flow: (1) /payroll wizard step 1 shows month + year selectors, (2) 'Show IFMIS budget balances for 2026-07' toggle is visible below the wizard, (3) clicking it renders BudgetBalancesPanel with all 6 seeded codes 110.01.001 / 110.02.001 / 110.02.002 / 120.01.001 / 310.01.001 / 310.01.002, each row showing Code / Ministry / Program / Allocated (SLE) + Edit button, (4) edit modal opens, saved allocated=99999999 with note → toast 'Allocation saved for 110.01.001' + row updates, (5) wizard preview → Run for July 2026 opens BudgetCheckModal with title 'Pre-payroll budget check · 2026-07', green verdict banner budget-check-verdict-safe, per-code table with 6 rows (budget-row-*), and a GREEN 'Confirm & run payroll' proceed button (bg #2D7A5D, enabled). (6) Clicking Confirm & run closes the modal and step 3 'Payroll completed' success view appears. ANTI-FRAUD PATH: (7) editing 110.01.001 → allocated_sle=1 and re-running triggers verdict pill 'over' (budget-check-verdict-over) with a DISABLED red proceed button (bg #B83A3A) and the budget-check-override-form appears; (8) override gating works exactly as spec: apply button DISABLED on empty reason, DISABLED with 10 chars, DISABLED with 30 chars but confirm≠OVERRIDE, ENABLED only when reason≥20 chars AND confirm='OVERRIDE'; (9) applying override → override-active banner (budget-check-override-notice) appears quoting 'Signed by you at <ts>' + reason quote, proceed button becomes ORANGE (bg #D1603D) with text 'Override & run payroll' and is enabled; (10) clicking it closes the modal and Payroll completed success screen appears. Allocation for 110.01.001 was reset to 50,000,000 SLE at the end so the tenant is not left mid-fraud. REGRESSION as demo tenant admin (admin@salonehcm.sl + TOTP): toggle-budget-balances is NOT rendered on /payroll and running payroll runs directly with NO budget-check-modal — original enterprise-tier behaviour intact. REGRESSION as gov admin: /civil-service loads, /transparency/government-of-sierra-leone public rollup renders, /careers/government-of-sierra-leone still lists 10 open postings — no regressions from the guardrail wiring.

issues: The override banner uses 'you' as the signer label (hard-coded in BudgetCheck.jsx line 40 — `override: { by: 'you', ... }`). Task spec says the banner should show 'your email + reason quote'. The actual signed-by email is only known server-side and would arrive on the next re-fetch of the check. Minor cosmetic — the reason quote is shown correctly, and the audit record on the backend does capture the real user id. Consider replacing 'you' with `user?.email` from AuthContext for a nicer UX.

critical_code_review_comments: BudgetCheck.jsx (388 lines) is well-decomposed into 7 sub-components (ModalHeader, VerdictBanner, BudgetTable, VerdictPill, UnallocatedList, OverrideForm, BudgetBalancesPanel) — cleanly under the 700-line ceiling.

All interactive elements carry data-testid — testability is excellent (budget-check-modal, budget-check-verdict-<v>, budget-check-table, budget-row-<code>, budget-check-override-form, budget-check-override-reason, budget-check-override-confirm, budget-check-override-apply, budget-check-override-notice, budget-check-proceed, budget-check-cancel, budget-balance-row-<code>, budget-balance-edit-<code>, budget-balance-edit-modal, budget-balance-alloc-input, budget-balance-note-input, budget-balance-save, budget-balance-cancel, toggle-budget-balances).

Gating logic in OverrideForm is defensive at THREE levels: (a) client-side disabled state on the apply button, (b) applyOverride() early-return on invalid input, (c) backend enforcement per test_iter29_budget_check.py — good defense in depth.

The override optimistic UI (line 40 `setCheck({ ...check, override: { by: 'you', ... } })`) hard-codes 'you' as the signer. If the server response for POST /payroll-budget/override returns the resolved user identity, prefer using that. As-is, refreshing the modal would show the real audit signer while the initial UX shows 'you'.
doRun in Payroll.jsx correctly gates on isGov = has('gov_payroll') so demo/enterprise tenants bypass the modal entirely — verified via regression test.

onBudgetConfirmed does NOT pass the check_id (or the override flag) to executeRun — the backend must therefore look up the latest check for the (tenant, period) tuple. Since backend test_iter29_budget_check.py confirms this works, it's fine, but worth being aware that the UI's 'confirm' click is a fire-and-forget from a data-contract standpoint.

The BudgetCheckModal calls POST /payroll-budget/check on mount and stores the result in state — no debouncing / no cancellation on unmount. If a user opens+closes rapidly the check may still resolve after unmount and try to setState (setCheck) on an unmounted component — will just log a React warning but is minor.

BudgetBalancesPanel loads codes from /civil-service/budget-codes AND balances from /payroll-budget/balances then merges — nice pattern; codes without balances show '— none —' in red which clearly signals the ghost-worker vector.

The verdict pill color mapping is missing 'unallocated_employees' → the header banner handles it but the per-row pill would fall through to the default grey. Minor: per-code rows never carry 'unallocated_employees' as a per-row verdict anyway (that's an aggregate-only verdict), so this is fine in practice.

success_rate.backend: not tested (per request — backend fully covered by test_iter29_budget_check.py)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (34/34 flow checks pass across gov safe path, gov anti-fraud path with full gating logic, and both regressions)

One additional payroll run was created for demo tenant period 2026-07 as part of the regression verification. Main agent may want to clean up test runs if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter29 anti-fraud guardrail UI is fully validated. Note: the current period at time of testing was 2026-07 (July 2026), not 2026-01 — task spec used YYYY-MM as a placeholder. When retesting, remember: (a) after 30s a fresh TOTP is needed for demo tenant; (b) always context.clear_cookies() AND evaluate sessionStorage.clear()+localStorage.clear() AND page.reload() when switching tenants — otherwise cached AuthContext / features can leave stale gov branding + gov feature gates active for the demo login which will produce a false 'toggle still visible' failure; (c) the seeded gov period 2026-07 already has multiple runs after these tests — future backup runs may need to happen in a different period; (d) override signer label is hard-coded to 'you' in the optimistic UI which is a known cosmetic quirk noted under design_issues.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. Only nit: BudgetCheck.jsx line 40 hardcodes override.by='you' in optimistic UI. Recommended one-line fix: `by: user?.email || 'you'` — pull `user` from AuthContext and pass through props (already available in Payroll.jsx as `user`).
